summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Blueseatra after MongoDB to Supabase PostgreSQL migration. Backend: 60/61 tests passed (98.4%). Frontend: Login, catalogs page, CSV import wizard all functional. Fixed critical pg_adapter.py bug (update_one missing return value). All security features verified: 15MB upload limit, CORS properly configured, AI keys encrypted.

fixed_bugs.issue: update_one() method returned None instead of UpdateResult object with matched_count attribute
fixed_bugs.fix_applied: Added UpdateResult class and return statement in update_one() method

integration_issues.issue: Catalog items dialog opens but shows 0 items even though backend returns items
integration_issues.note: Backend GET /catalogs/{id}/items returns items correctly, but frontend may have rendering issue or data mapping problem

integration_issues.issue: No quotes found for uidemo@blueseatra.com user to test quote editor
integration_issues.note: This is expected if user hasn't created any quotes yet. Quote editor UI elements are present in code.
